meaning: Register the existing checked operation route in the adopted esse sense: attribute the same occurring episode to its bearer as intellectual exercise, obtain a respect in which that bearer is in act, then apply actuality-to-esse to that same bearer and respect. Both analyst exercise bridges remain open premises; the causation-only q75 reading is not applied to thought. This is a conditional instantiation/transcription, not independent warrant for those bridges or a new proof. It supplies no occurrence, bearer, selected-world existence, bodily independence or subsistence witness.
